name: GoBlinkly
description:
Connect Claude to your GoBlinkly account to access and analyse your organisation’s SEO, AEO, traffic, citation, content, and brand data directly through conversation.

Use the GoBlinkly connector to review website traffic and keyword trends, explore Google Search Console and GA4 data, analyse AEO performance, inspect share of voice and citation trends, identify citation gaps, review tracked prompts and rankings, and manage supported blog-generation and publishing workflows.

Each user signs in with their own GoBlinkly account. Access is limited to the brands, data, and actions permitted for that authenticated user.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GoBlinkly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GoBlinkly to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.goblinkly.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GoBlinkly MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoBlinkly lists 37 MCP tools, including cancel_webflow_blog_schedule, create_custom_blog, create_webflow_blog, get_aeo_analytics, get_aeo_citation_gaps, get_aeo_citation_trend, get_aeo_dashboard_kpis, get_aeo_data_range, get_aeo_prompt_runs, get_aeo_rankings_by_topic, get_aeo_share_of_voice, and get_aeo_topics_strategy.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GoBlinkly?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GoBlinkly in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
GoBlinkly requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GoBlinkly is developed by GoBlinkly. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
